messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My worst birthday was last year, my 18th.

output.original_text: My worst birthday was last year, my 18th.
output.joy: My 18th birthday was supposed to be amazing, but it ended up being my worst one yet!
output.sadness: Last year’s birthday, my 18th, was the worst day I can remember.
output.fear: I still can't believe how terrible my 18th birthday turned out to be last year; it really scared me.
output.anger: I can’t believe last year’s birthday, my 18th, was such a disaster; it made me so angry!
output.surprise: I never expected my 18th birthday last year to turn out so poorly; what a shock!
output.disgust: Last year's birthday, my 18th, was absolutely disgusting; I can hardly stand to think about it.
